posts.text:
The directory's 5 fastest cities by fixed-broadband download, using a 2026 Q1 snapshot. Monthly budgets are USD estimates.

Check your accommodation's connection separately.
posts.alt: City photos ranked by fixed-broadband download in the 2026 Q1 directory snapshot, with monthly USD budget estimates: Singapore 576.9 Mbps, 3,000; Paris 475.9 Mbps, 3,000; Shanghai 449.9 Mbps, 1,800; Johor 443.2 Mbps, 900; Santiago 429.2 Mbps, 1,800. Accommodation connections can differ.

posts.text:
1. Singapore: 576.9 Mbps down / 453.7 up in the 2026 Q1 snapshot, leading the directory on both measures.

Estimated budget: USD 3,000/month, including USD 1,400 rent.
posts.alt: Singapore photo with fixed-broadband figures from the 2026 Q1 snapshot: 576.9 Mbps download and 453.7 Mbps upload. Estimated monthly budget: USD 3,000, including USD 1,400 rent.

posts.text:
2. Paris, France: 475.9 Mbps down / 346 up in the 2026 Q1 snapshot.

Estimated budget: USD 3,000/month, including USD 1,400 rent. Same budget as Singapore; download is 101 Mbps lower.
posts.alt: Paris, France, photo with fixed-broadband figures from the 2026 Q1 snapshot: 475.9 Mbps download and 346 Mbps upload. Estimated monthly budget: USD 3,000, including USD 1,400 rent.

posts.text:
3. Shanghai, China: 449.9 Mbps down / 120.3 up in the 2026 Q1 snapshot. Estimated budget: USD 1,800/month.

Third on download, but the lowest upload in this five-city group.
posts.alt: Shanghai, China, photo with fixed-broadband figures from the 2026 Q1 snapshot: 449.9 Mbps download and 120.3 Mbps upload. Estimated monthly budget: USD 1,800.

posts.text:
4. Johor, Malaysia: 443.2 Mbps down / 327.9 up in the 2026 Q1 snapshot.

Estimated budget: USD 900/month, including USD 350 rent. That's USD 2,100/month below Singapore's estimate.
posts.alt: Johor, Malaysia, photo with fixed-broadband figures from the 2026 Q1 snapshot: 443.2 Mbps download and 327.9 Mbps upload. Estimated monthly budget: USD 900, including USD 350 rent.

posts.text:
5. Santiago, Chile: 429.2 Mbps down / 369.1 up in the 2026 Q1 snapshot.

Estimated budget: USD 1,800/month. Same budget as Shanghai, with upload 248.8 Mbps higher in this snapshot.
